goals.objective: Build and maintain the requested cybersecurity project portfolio: (1) defensive ML-powered web application firewall, (2) a safe, non-deployable modular C2 simulation/lab project, (3) CI/CD pipeline exposure management, and (4) automated incident-response playbook (SOAR). Create a seamless Tellnova automation workflow for ongoing implementation and periodic GitHub commits, using the configured repository only after safeguards and repository configuration are in place.
